Name: Nadine's Tools n Tackle Box
Author: viccallan
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Adds a tool chest and tackle box using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url][/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]install SMAPI[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]download mod[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]unzip and copy the [FF] Tools n Tackle folder into the mod folder. Or use the vortex mod manager.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Adds a tool chest and tackle box they act like the dressers and was inspired by Poplinp's Armory Cabinet.[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Classic red tool chest and a tackle box[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]White tool chest and tackle box to match [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Pink tool chest and tackle box   [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Joja Blue tool chest and tackle box[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Joja Gray tool chest and tackle box [/color][/*]
[/list]Has GMCM options.

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Future Plans[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Create colour options and tabs to match popular UI's.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Currently have tabs to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39379]Cat Valley[/url] and another light UI one that I can't recall the name of at the moment. But don't know how to implement them.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Also a CP version.[/color]


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][size=3]SMAPI[/size][/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod was inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40264]Poplinp's Armory Cabinet[/url].[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Concerned Ape for making a wonderful game.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Pathoschild for making  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Leroymilo for making  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url][/color]

[b][size=4]Disclaimer[/size][/b]
[size=3]No AI used in the making of this mod.[/size]
